headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key. Optional: search_funds and get_fund answer 10 calls per caller per UTC day with no key at all. No registration or email is required. Agents self-register at https://fundmomentum.vc/_api/agent/register with just an agent_name and get a key plus 25 free credits usable on all six tools, or skip keys entirely and pay per call over MPP (Tempo USDC) when a paid tool answers HTTP 402. A free human key (100 calls/month) is at https://fundmomentum.vc/pricing.
